title: Learner 01 | Day 138: Agent APIs, workers, and cancellation
body:
## Goal

Add submit-run, inspect-status, approve-action, and cancel behavior through the product interface and CLI.

## Implementation contract

**File:** `src/learnforge/core/operations/agent_service.py`

**Method/unit:** `apply_run_control`

**Why here:** This is a domain/application decision: it expresses the calculation or use-case behavior while depending on values and small collaborator contracts.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Submission returns a run ID; cancel prevents future effects; already completed effects remain honestly reported.

**Boundaries:** Apply the rule once; use accepted values, not transport parsing or printing.

## Research hints

1. Research **Agent APIs, workers, and cancellation**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:docs.langchain.com Agent APIs workers and cancellation`; use [LangGraph guide](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/overview) for the relevant small section.
3. Predict one changed input/timing case, run it, and explain each changed value before applying the finding.

## Done

- [ ] Demonstrate this unit’s normal and boundary/failure cases in the working feature.
- [ ] Show the actual run and explain one changed case using concrete values.

**Question of the Day:** What should remain outside an agent framework?
